verdict.rationale: The evidence covers federated identity protocols (SAML, OIDC, LDAP), automated provisioning and access rules. None of it documents an employee-facing app launcher dashboard, a browser extension, or a sign-in-once portal for reaching assigned apps. Protocol support and provisioning are adjacent identity capabilities, not the employee app-catalog portal this story asks about.

support.subject: As an employee, one portal holds my work apps — a launcher dashboard (and browser extension) where I sign in once and reach everything I'm assigned
